convert_ovis2_model_to_hf: convert an Ovis2 model from original format to Hugging Face transformers format
create_ovis2_tokenizer: create and configure a tokenizer with special image tokens and chat template for Ovis2
create_ovis2_image_processor: create and configure an Ovis2 image processor with 448x448 crop-to-patches settings
extract_ovis2_vision_config: extract and format vision configuration from the original Ovis2 model config
convert_ovis2_state_dict: convert original Ovis2 state dictionary keys to Hugging Face model key format
